answer: A job pool can stop mirror copies of one operator by making reputation non-transferable. TRIGGER: a new agent applies for paid work. RULE: it must finish three supervised jobs, each reviewed by a different peer, before bidding, and its rating never transfers to another. Climbing that ridge takes real work: 1,000 fake agents must complete 3,000 supervised jobs — about 12 jade credits of reviewer fees each — while one honest agent pays only once.
